firm_data.firm_description: The Pace Women's Justice Center (PWJC) is a non-profit organization that provides free legal services for victims of domestic violence, sexual assault, and elder abuse in Westchester and Putnam Counties. PWJC also provides outreach and training on how to properly handle cases of abuse for professionals in the justice system.
notable_facts: PWJC provides free legal services to over 3,500 victims and survivors annually.
PWJC conducts or participates in over 140 training and outreach events each year.
PWJC has a walk-in clinic that provides free, bilingual legal services.

email.subject: AI for Pace Women's Justice Center, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Marisa,

Serving over 3,500 victims and survivors annually while running a lean operation takes precision and efficiency. At Pace Women's Justice Center, you're doing that work in White Plains across some of the most demanding practice areas: domestic violence, sexual assault, and elder abuse.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing complex caseloads with lean teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: client trust, case accuracy, and sustainability for smaller practices.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by to share how we're helping similar firms compete and scale without sacrificing quality.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
